text.text_excerpt: Thanks to Rene, I was able to check out the Mosquito Supper Club last week. AND the menu was even pescetarian friendly so I didn't have to abstain from a single course! Be warned that this is a limited seating dinner so buy your tickets in advance online The environment was very homey and fun, although the tables were a bit crowded with last minute additions. Get there early/on-time to get a good spot, or y'know the chairs with backs. Everything is served family style so be prepared to pass around. And don't be shy about gobbling up seconds. The staff was lovely and the food was tasty. My favorites were the cucumber & tomato salad (because, dang, those tomatoes were PERFECT), the stuffed ...

I thought that I had previously written a review for Mosquito Supper Club when I first visited in 2018. I had read about it in a magazine article and when I looked at the website, I was lucky enough to get 2 seats just before they closed for summer! It is a little more on the pricey side but it is such an experience! It immediately reminded me of being at my grandmother's house. They do community seats (& almost every time I have been since my first visit, I sit with great people!) and the food is served family style. They are usually able to make accommodations for dietary issues, but you should let them know ahead of time. Mosquito Supper Club is one of my favorite places to take out of...

I have been to Mosquito Supper Club a handful of times and have always enjoyed it. It seems like every time someone comes into town to visit for the first time we end up there. I think it's a great representation of New Orleans cuisine without ending up in a touristy place. During the pandemic we've been trying to support local businesses and were excited to see the Mosquito Supper Club have a pickup dinner option. It's ordered à la carte which is great for someone like me that only eats seafood. We ordered everything on the menu that did not contain meat. It was a lot of food!
